title: How soap works, your oils, and handling caustic soda safely
course_title: Soap Making for Small Business: Cold-Process Bars and Simple Liquid Soap

say: How soap works, your oils, and handling caustic soda safely.
This is the video for Module 1 of Soap Making for Small Business.
Every true soap is made from two things. Fats or oils, and a strong alkali called lye.

panel.heading: Soap is oil plus lye
items: Oils or fats + a strong alkali called lye
Bars: sodium hydroxide, or caustic soda
Liquid soap: potassium hydroxide, or KOH
The reaction is called saponification
Result: soap and glycerin, no lye left

say: For bar soap, the lye is sodium hydroxide. In our markets it is sold as caustic soda.

say: With melt-and-pour, you melt a ready soap base. You never touch lye, but the base is costly.
Cold process needs care and about 4 to 6 weeks of curing, but gives the lowest cost per bar and full control. Most small soap businesses choose it.
Palm oil gives a hard, long-lasting bar with creamy lather. It can be 25% to 50% of your recipe.

panel.heading: What each oil does in your bar
items: Palm oil: hard, long-lasting bar, 25% to 50%
Palm kernel oil: cleaning and lather, 15% to 30%
Shea butter: creamy and conditioning, 5% to 15%
Castor oil: boosts lather, 3% to 8%

say: Palm kernel oil, P K O, adds hardness, strong cleaning and big bubbles. Keep it at 15% to 30%, because too much can be drying.

say: Caustic soda burns skin and can blind you. It does not always sting at once, so treat it like boiling oil.
Halima in Kaduna wants a safe soap corner. She picks a table by the back door, so she can mix lye outside.
She buys sealed goggles for about 2,500 naira, nitrile gloves for about 3,500, and a digital scale for about 6,000. These prices are approximate.
That is about 12,000 naira in total.
She labels a stainless pot and a P P 5 jug soap only. Never aluminium, because lye attacks it. And no one cooks while lye is out.
Step one. Goggles, gloves over the wrists, long sleeves and closed shoes. Children and pets out. Work outdoors or by an open window.

panel.heading: Mixing lye safely
items: Protection on. Children and pets out.
Weigh cold water into a heat-safe container.
Weigh caustic soda into a separate dry container.
Slowly pour the soda into the water, stirring.
Step back. It can pass 80 degrees Celsius.

say: Step two. Weigh cold water, distilled or boiled and cooled, into a heat-safe container.

say: If lye touches your skin, remove the clothing and rinse with cool running water for at least 15 minutes. Do not use vinegar. Water is the correct first treatment.

panel.heading: First aid: know it before you start

cards.d: Remove soaked clothing. Rinse with cool running water for at least 15 minutes. No vinegar.
Rinse with clean running water for at least 15 minutes, eyelids open. Go to hospital.
Rinse the mouth. Do not make the person vomit. Get medical help immediately.

say: If it gets in the eyes, rinse with clean running water for at least 15 minutes, holding the eyelids open, and go to a hospital straight away.

say: To remember. Weigh, never guess. Cold process needs curing time. Local oils make a good base. Caustic soda goes into water. And store it sealed, labelled, never in a drink bottle.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Soap is oil plus lye; weigh, never guess
Cold process: low cost, full control, 4 to 6 weeks cure
Palm oil, palm kernel oil and shea make a good local base
Caustic soda into water, never the other way
Store caustic soda sealed, labelled, out of children's reach
